- 7.60 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

I’ll resend it unchanged, since there’s no confirmed fit result to guide an adjustment. The hex pocket is 8.4 mm across flats; the retaining lips project inward from that pocket. Please print the coupon first and check that the nut presses in by hand and stays in when inverted.

{"note":"Resubmitted unchanged: no usable fit result was available. Main hex pocket is 8.4 mm across flats, not 7.6 mm; inward retaining lips locally narrow the opening. One printed knob captures one ISO 4032 M5 nut without glue. Optional coupon is a separate test print, not part of the assembly. Nominal nut dimensions are unverified; test before printing the knob. For light hand tightening only.","questions":[{"text":"Can you measure the nut across flats and thickness?","answer":"Cannot measure; use best judgment."},{"text":"How did the previous prints fit?","answer":"No confirmed fit result for either print; reported pocket label was 7.60 mm."}],"params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"knob_h":{"value":9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_h":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"pocket_af_clearance":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total across-flats clearance; main hex pocket AF is nut_af plus this value."},"bolt_d_clearance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_width":{"value":3.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_wall":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_slot":{"value":0.65,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_root_z":{"value":2.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_inner_overlap":{"value":0.1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_projection":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Inward projection from pocket flat; nominal overlap with seated nut is 0.3 mm."},"lip_above_nut":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_lower_ramp_h":{"value":0.25,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_upper_ramp_h":{"value":0.75,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_count":{"value":12,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_radius":{"value":1.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_center_radius":{"value":15.7,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":18,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","code":"import math

def build(p):
    h=p.knob_h
    a=(p.nut_af+p.pocket_af_clearance)/2
    r=2*a/math.sqrt(3)
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(h)
    for i in range(int(p.grip_count)):
        t=2*math.pi*i/p.grip_count
        cut=cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.grip_center_radius*math.cos(t),p.grip_center_radius*math.sin(t)).circle(p.grip_radius).extrude(h)
        body=body.cut(cut)
    pts=[(r*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),r*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    pocket=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_h).polyline(pts).close().extrude(h-p.floor_h)
    body=body.cut(pocket).cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_d_clearance)/2).extrude(h))
    w=p.tab_width
    x1=a+p.tab_wall
    x2=x1+p.tab_slot
    z=p.tab_root_z
    def boxcut(xlo,xhi,ylo,yhi):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').box(xhi-xlo,yhi-ylo,h-z,centered=(False,False,False)).translate((xlo,ylo,z))
    slots=boxcut(x1,x2,-w/2-p.tab_slot,w/2+p.tab_slot)
    slots=slots.union(boxcut(a-p.slot_inner_overlap,x2,w/2,w/2+p.tab_slot))
    slots=slots.union(boxcut(a-p.slot_inner_overlap,x2,-w/2-p.tab_slot,-w/2))
    low=p.floor_h+p.nut_h+p.lip_above_nut
    profile=[(a,low),(a-p.lip_projection,low+p.lip_lower_ramp_h),(a,low+p.lip_lower_ramp_h+p.lip_upper_ramp_h)]
    lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(w/2,both=True)
    for angle in (0,120,240):
        body=body.cut(slots.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
        body=body.union(lip.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    return body.clean()
","print_orientation":"Flat circular shoulder face down at z=0. Pocket and retaining tabs face up. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut inserts from the z=9 pocket opening; bolt axis is Z."},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","code":"import math

def build(p):
    h=p.knob_h
    a=(p.nut_af+p.pocket_af_clearance)/2
    r=2*a/math.sqrt(3)
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(h)
    pts=[(r*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),r*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_h).polyline(pts).close().extrude(h-p.floor_h))
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_d_clearance)/2).extrude(h))
    w=p.tab_width
    x1=a+p.tab_wall
    x2=x1+p.tab_slot
    z=p.tab_root_z
    def boxcut(xlo,xhi,ylo,yhi):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').box(xhi-xlo,yhi-ylo,h-z,centered=(False,False,False)).translate((xlo,ylo,z))
    slots=boxcut(x1,x2,-w/2-p.tab_slot,w/2+p.tab_slot)
    slots=slots.union(boxcut(a-p.slot_inner_overlap,x2,w/2,w/2+p.tab_slot))
    slots=slots.union(boxcut(a-p.slot_inner_overlap,x2,-w/2-p.tab_slot,-w/2))
    low=p.floor_h+p.nut_h+p.lip_above_nut
    lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(a,low),(a-p.lip_projection,low+p.lip_lower_ramp_h),(a,low+p.lip_lower_ramp_h+p.lip_upper_ramp_h)]).close().extrude(w/2,both=True)
    for angle in (0,120,240):
        body=body.cut(slots.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
        body=body.union(lip.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    return body.clean()

Nut must remain captured and tabs must return inward without whitening or cracks."}},{"id":"shoulder","part":"knob","feature":"3 mm thick floor surrounding 5.6 mm bolt passage","relation":"supports","hardware":"nut","params":["floor_h","bolt_d","bolt_d_clearance","nut_af"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Press seated nut toward floor with thumb: it must not pass through opposite face."}},{"id":"bolt_passage","part":"knob","feature":"Axial 5.6 mm through-hole aligned with nut thread","relation":"clears","params":["bolt_d","bolt_d_clearance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Thread your M5 bolt through captured nut by fingers; it must emerge through opposite face without binding on plastic."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print fit_coupon first in PLA at 0.2 mm layers with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 4 walls and 100% infill. Disable supports. Use the same settings for knob. Keep narrow tab slots clear of brim, support and debris.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"tool":"Slicer"},{"n":"2","text":"Let coupon cool. Align nut flats with hex pocket. Push straight down evenly with your thumb until it passes the three lips and rests on the floor. Do not hammer, heat, or use pliers; stop if it requires more than firm finger pressure or tabs whiten.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"Confirm nut is entirely recessed, cannot turn in the pocket, and remains captured with opening facing down and gentle shaking. Try your M5 bolt from the pocket side: it must thread normally and emerge through the floor hole. If fit fails, do not print the full knob: reduce lip_projection by 0.1 mm for excessive insertion force, or increase it by 0.1 mm for poor retention, then retest. Change pocket_af_clearance only if the hex pocket itself binds the nut. A cracked tab requires a fresh print.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"Recover the test nut by gently deflecting the tabs outward while easing nut up; do not lever against one tab. If necessary sacrifice the coupon rather than damage the nut. Print knob with verified parameters, flat floor face on bed, pocket up, no supports.","parts":["fit_coupon","knob"],"hardware":["nut"],"tool":"Slicer"},{"n":"5","text":"Press nut into knob as tested. Repeat inverted retention and bolt-passage checks. Coupon is not used in final assembly; knob is the only printed component.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"Thread onto your M5 bolt and tighten by hand only. This is a captive-nut knob, not a bolt-head socket: it turns the nut on the bolt. Stop if plastic distorts or nut starts rotating. Keep away from heat and inspect tabs after any nut removal.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
